ሰርተፊኬት ክፍሊ 10ን መንነትን ሒዝኩም መጹ።

eligibility: ናብ TVET መደብ ዝምዝገብ ዝኾነ ሰብ።
howToApply: ቅድሚ 2026-11-30 ኣብ TVET መደብ ተመዝገቡ ከምኡውን ንሓደ ወርሒ 400 ETB ክፈሉ።

rows.sourceText: Your restaurant will be inspected on 2026-11-28. Close the kitchen during the inspection. Have the food handler certificates ready for the inspectors.

explanation.summary: Health inspectors visit your restaurant on 2026-11-28.

actions.step: Be ready for the inspection on 2026-11-28.
Keep the food handler certificates available.

eligibility: Restaurant owners scheduled for inspection.
howToApply: Close the kitchen during the inspection on 2026-11-28.

rows.sourceText: Your water bill of ETB 850 for October is unpaid. Water service will be disconnected after 2026-11-20. Pay at any Commercial Bank branch or with telebirr.

explanation.summary: Your water bill is unpaid. Water will be cut off after 2026-11-20.

actions.step: Pay the water bill of ETB 850 before 2026-11-20.
Pay at a Commercial Bank branch or with telebirr.

eligibility: Households with an unpaid October water bill.
howToApply: Pay the ETB 850 October bill to stop disconnection.

rows.sourceText: Your shipment has arrived at Modjo dry port. Clear it by 2026-12-10 to avoid storage charges of ETB 150 per day. Bring the bill of lading and your TIN certificate.

explanation.summary: Your shipment is at the port. Clear it by 2026-12-10 or pay storage daily.

actions.step: Clear your shipment by 2026-12-10.
Bring the bill of lading and TIN certificate.

eligibility: Owners of the shipment that arrived at Modjo dry port.
howToApply: Clear the shipment at Modjo dry port by 2026-12-10.

rows.sourceText: ልጅዎ በ2026-12-05 በጤና ማዕከሉ የሽፍታ ክትባት ማግኘት አለበት። የልጁን የክትባት ካርድ ይዘው ይምጡ። ክትባቱ ነፃ ነው።

actions.step: ልጅዎን በ2026-12-05 ለሽፍታ ክትባት ይውሰዱ።
የክትባት ካርዱን ይዘው ይምጡ።

eligibility: የሽፍታ ክትባት የሚያስፈልጋቸው ህጻናት።
howToApply: የልጁን የምስክር ወረቀት ወደ ጤና ማዕከሉ ይዘው ይምጡ።
